'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**A [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] kills two members of the [[Egypt]]ian [[Egyptian Armed Forces|Armed Forces]] and injures five others near [[Bir al-Abd]] in the [[North Sinai Governorate]]. [https://apnews.com/article/police-egypt-middle-east-islamic-state-group-bombings-94f6eadebb7c9ecd430f652192fd2ca1 (AP)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**Six militia members are killed during clashes between the [[Nduma Defense of Congo-Renovated]] and Mai-Mai Kabido in Bukumbirwa. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/01/03/actualite/securite/nouvel-au-nord-kivu-6-miliciens-morts-dans-des-combats-entre-deux (Radio Okapi)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*On New Year's Day, [[Pope Francis]] livestreams his message from the library of the Apostolic Palace. He states "the Virgin Mary’s motherly care encourages us to use our God-given time for building up the world and peace, not destroying it." In the Catholic Church, January 1 is the [[Solemnity of Mary, the Holy Mother of God]]. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-francis-with-marys-help-fill-the-new-year-with-spiritual-growth-50199 (Catholic News Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Tribistovo poisoning]]
**Eight people aged 19 die from [[carbon monoxide poisoning]] in a cottage in [[Tribistovo]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]], during a [[New Year]]'s celebration, after [[carbon monoxide]] leaks from a [[Electric generator|generator]] used to power a heater. [https://apnews.com/article/new-years-eve-holidays-carbon-monoxide-poisoning-poisoning-sarajevo-3456a032b215f414f292edfc1b3eb7eb (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in London]]
******The [[United Kingdom]] [[Secretary of State for Education]] [[Gavin Williamson]] announces that all primary schools in [[London]] will remain closed for at least two weeks at the start of the new term on January 4. It was previously announced that only schools in 23 of the 32 boroughs would be closed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-55511169 (BBC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Isle of Man]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****The [[Isle of Man]] reports two cases of a new [[Variants of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|variant]] of [[SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-isle-of-man-55503507 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Turkey]] reports its first 15 cases of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in people who traveled from the United Kingdom and later tested positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-suspends-entries-from-uk-after-15-cases-of-new-covid-19-variant/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
****Turkey bans all travelers from the United Kingdom due to the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from the United Kingdom. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-europe-coronavirus-pandemic-united-kingdom-84176d598340dee3ada03748752a6fd3 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] announces it will tighten curfews in 15 [[Departments of France|departments]] beginning tomorrow at 6:00 p.m. local time in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20210101-france-tightens-covid-19-curfew-in-worst-affected-areas (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Norway]]
****[[Norway]] will lift its ban on flights from the United Kingdom beginning tomorrow at 4:00 p.m. [[GMT]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/norway-uk-travel-ban-lifted-flights-b1781203.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] approves the emergency use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] developed by the [[University of Oxford]] and [[AstraZeneca]], becoming the third country in the world to do so after the United Kingdom and [[Argentina]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/1/astrazeneca-vaccine-set-to-become-first-one-approved-in-india (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Israel]] becomes the first country to vaccinate at least 10% of its population against COVID-19, with around 950,000 doses already administered. [https://www.jpost.com/health-science/israel-has-vaccinated-over-10-times-more-of-its-population-than-the-us-653966 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] extends the recovery phase of the [[2020 Malaysia movement control order|Movement Control Order]] (MCO) nationwide except for [[Selangor]], [[Kuala Lumpur]], and [[Sabah]] as well as other locations under a conditional and enhanced MCO until March 31 due to a substantial increase in the number of new cases. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-extends-recovery-movement-control-order-to-mar-31 (''The Straits Times'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] includes the [[United States]] in its [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic|travel ban]] of countries and territories reported to have new variants of SARS-CoV-2, which comes into effect on January 3. The move comes after the United States reported its first case of [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|a new variant]] from the United Kingdom on December 30. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-01/01/c_139634794.htm (Xinhua)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]], [[501.V2 Variant]]
****The [[Singaporean]] [[Ministry of Health (Singapore)|Ministry of Health]] announces that long-term pass holders and short-term visitors who had travel history to [[South Africa]] over the past 14 days will be not allowed to enter Singapore starting January 4, due to reports of a more contagious variant of SARS-CoV-2 circulating in the country. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/travel/singapore-to-block-entry-to-visitors-from-south-africa/story-GPsiXvkf4Cjndw5uA14KcI.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Bangkok]] will close all schools, daycare centers for both children and seniors, preschools and tutoring centers from January 4 to 17. Other public facilities will be closed beginning January 2. This comes as the authorities tighten measures to reduce the spread of a new wave of COVID-19. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/bangkok-to-close-schools-for-two-weeks-as-number-of-covid-19-13877296 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
****[[California]] reports a record 585 new deaths in the past 24 hours. [https://abc7.com/california-covid-deaths-record-covid19-covid-19/9269869 (KABC-TV)]
***The United States surpasses 20 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-surpasses-20-million-cases-of-coronavirus-on-first-day-of-2021/ (CBS News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chad]]
***[[Demographics of Chad|Chadian]] [[President of Chad|President]] [[Idriss Déby]] signs a decree that imposes a [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] in the country's capital [[N'Djamena]] for the first time since the pandemic began and also declares a dusk-to-dawn curfew due to a rise in the number of cases. [https://www.reuters.com/article/healthNews/idUSKBN2961XC?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uruguay]]
***[[Uruguay]] reports a record of 12 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 193. [https://www.elpais.com.uy/informacion/salud/coronavirus-record-muertes-casos-activos-tasa-positividad-alta.html (''El País'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**[[Taiwan|Taiwanese]] [[President of the Republic of China|President]] [[Tsai Ing-wen]] says that she is ready to have talks with [[China]] and urges the country to have dialogues with Taiwan. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-01-01/taiwan-president-urges-china-to-pursue-dialog-not-conflict (Bloomberg)]
*[[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]], [[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] says [[Iran]] has notified it of its intention to enrich [[uranium]] to 20% purity, in accordance with a law recently passed by the [[Islamic Consultative Assembly]]. Iran did not specify when this enrichment would begin. The December 2020 bill, adopted after the [[Mohsen Fakhrizadeh#Assassination|assassination]] of [[Iranian peoples|Iranian]] [[nuclear scientist]] [[Mohsen Fakhrizadeh]], instructs the [[government of Iran|government]] to increase [[uranium enrichment]] if [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action#Sanctions|sanctions against Iran]] are not eased within two months. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20210101-iran-says-it-will-enrich-uranium-up-to-20-percent-un-nuclear-watchdog-says (France 24)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-55509048 (BBC News)]
*The [[African Continental Free Trade Area]], the largest [[free-trade area]] since the formation of the [[World Trade Organization]] in 1995, commences. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/1/1/after-months-of-covid-delays-african-free-trade-bloc-launches (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Cannabis in the United States]]
**[[2020 Montana Initiative 190|Initiative 190]] comes into effect in [[Montana]], making it the 13th state to [[Legality of cannabis by U.S. jurisdiction|legalize]] recreational [[cannabis]]. [https://www.greatfallstribune.com/story/news/2020/12/30/montana-law-take-effect-residents-can-grow-possess-pot/4086023001/ (''Great Falls Tribune'')] [https://www.krtv.com/news/montana-and-regional-news/now-legal-in-montana-recreational-use-of-marijuana (KRTV)]
*[[George Floyd protests in Portland, Oregon]], [[2020–2021 United States racial unrest]]
**On December 31 and into the early hours of January 1, protesters and police clashed in a [[New Year's Eve]] protest which police declared a riot shortly before midnight, alleging the demonstrators' use of violence. Within 30 minutes, police advanced on the demonstration, protesters used [[fireworks]] while officers shot [[pepper ball]]s, [[rubber bullet]]s, and other "less-lethal munitions". In the wake of the protests, the [[Portland Police Bureau]] order all people in the area to leave immediately. Authorities have not stated the number of protesters arrested. [https://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/news/532298-protesters-police-clash-in-portland-during-new-years-eve-riot (''The Hill'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[United States Senate]] votes 81–13 to override [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[veto]] of the [[National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021]]. This is the first successful veto override of the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump presidency]]. [https://www.businessinsider.com/senate-gives-trump-first-veto-override-defense-spending-bill-2021-1 (''Business Insider'')]
